title: Measuring the Acceleration-Dependent Temperature of the Minkowski Vacuum
summary: Relativistic quantum field theory is the structure on which the Standard Model and beyond-Standard Model physics are built. One of its most striking predictions is the Unruh effect: an observer undergoing uniform linear acceleration measures the Minkowski vacuum as a thermal bath at a fixed temperature. Despite decades of theoretical interest, this effect has never been directly observed.
